entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. A. A. Takalkar, App for the State.
Psi Sanil Patil, Pelhar Police Station

------------
 Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
 Date : January 20, 2023
 P.C. :
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State.
2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail.

The applicant is apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No. 1055 of 2022 registered with Pelhar Police Station, for the offence punishable under sections 188, 273, 328, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 with under sections 26(2)(iv) and 30(2)(a)
of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. Gutkha, pan masala and scented supari was found in the possession of the co-accused which is worth Darshan Patil 911-aba-190-23.doc Rs.9,67,495/-.
On the basis of the statement of the co- accused, the applicant is implicated.
There is nothing recovered from the applicant.
There are no criminal antecedents reported against the applicant.
The case of grant of interim protection is made out.
4. Learned APP seeks time to take instructions.

sentences.text:
5. Meantime in the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with C.R. No. 1055 of 2022,
registered with Pelhar Police Station, the applicant- Mohammad Shadab Abdul Qayyum Khan, be released on bail on his furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.

6. The applicant to appear before the Investigating Officer on 23/01/2023 and 24/01/2023 between 11.00 a.m. and 2.00 p.m. and to cooperate with the investigation.
7.

(M. S. KARNIK, J.)
